digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_family value map consolidation and boundary guard
propositions: The ticket-type map is defined in two places (Cloud and DC adapters) without a shared definition, creating risk of silent divergence between deployments at issue creation time.
The existing guard tests enforce one-literal rule for STATUS and PRIORITY maps but do not cover the TYPE map, allowing a third copy to be added undetected.
The two existing copies are content-identical (same four key-value pairs, differing only in key order), so consolidation to a single source preserves behavior on both deployments.

Both create-path consumers must import the TYPE map under the historical _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE alias to keep external test consumers (test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py) that read it as a module attribute from breaking.

The consolidation follows the established J2 pattern used for STATUS and PRIORITY maps: move to value_maps.py, import via absolute form (required for spec_from_file_location test loading), and extend the boundary guard to all three maps.
